newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Nov 29 IMF U.S.-SDR rate.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Nov 29 IMF U.S.-SDR rate.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund's opening exchange value of the U.S. dollar against the SDR for Friday, November 29 is currently unavailable.
The IMF did not issue a rate for Thursday due to the Thanksgiving holiday. The IMF said Wednesday's U.S.-SDR rate was 1.44816, versus 1.44846 on Tuesday.

It also said that for the week beginning November 25, the rate of interest and charges on the SDR is 3.92 percent, and the rate of remuneration on members' creditor positions is also 3.92 percent. The rate of charge on members' use of fund credit is 4.29 percent for the week.
